profile.name: Erudita Zilbeari
profile.role: Full-Stack Web & Mobile Developer · UI/UX Designer
profile.headline: Crafting refined digital products with code and design.
profile.about: I'm Erudita, a full-stack developer and UI/UX designer building software where engineering precision meets exceptional design. From AI-powered platforms and complex operational dashboards to mobile apps and production websites for real businesses, I turn ambitious ideas into polished digital products that are built to work, built to scale, and built to stand out. My experience spans 20+ projects, international hackathons, competition-winning work, and client projects across borders, but my standard remains the same: make it functional, make it exceptional, and never make it ordinary.
profile.availabilityText: Available for 3 new client projects this month

projects.title: Pyramid Backstage — Admin Platform
projects.description: A full-stack event operations platform built during JunctionX Tirana 2026 for managing complex venue workflows. The admin dashboard centralizes event creation, space matching, scheduling, equipment reservations, proposals, task coordination, staff management, and operational readiness. It features AI-assisted event planning, a visual Digital Twin, automatic conflict detection, Kanban-based operations, readiness scoring, and real-time synchronization with the connected staff mobile app.
projects.technologies: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Supabase, TanStack Router, Framer Motion, Lucide React

projects.title: Pizzeria Paradiso
projects.description: Italian restaurant and pizzeria in Vaduz, Liechtenstein serving freshly prepared pizzas, pasta, salads and desserts with dine-in, takeaway, online ordering, delivery and table reservations.
projects.headline: Fresh. Authentic. Italian.
projects.problem: Guests needed one clear place to explore authentic Italian dishes, reserve a table and choose dine-in, takeaway, online ordering or delivery.
projects.solution: I built a responsive restaurant platform focused on quality ingredients, modern atmosphere, friendly service and fast booking/order paths.
projects.results: Guests can quickly discover pizzas, pasta, salads and desserts, then order online or reserve a table at Schwefelstrasse 14.
projects.timeline: 3-day production sprint from structure to polished launch.

projects.title: Real Estate Dashboard
projects.description: CRM dashboard for listings, leads, agent activity, revenue and pipeline visibility.
projects.headline: Every lead in view.
projects.problem: Agents needed a clearer view of listings, lead status and revenue movement.
projects.solution: I designed a CRM-style dashboard with pipeline cards, listing metrics and agent views.
projects.results: Lead state and listing performance became easier to compare at a glance.
projects.timeline: Dashboard sprint covering CRM shell, cards and analytics states.

projects.title: Hospital Management System
projects.description: Management system for patients, doctors, appointments, billing and operational reports.
projects.headline: Care operations, organized.
projects.problem: Hospital workflows needed structured records, scheduling and billing in one system.
projects.solution: I implemented role-based modules for patients, doctors, appointments, billing and reports.
projects.results: The system organizes daily operations into clearer admin workflows.
projects.timeline: School-scale full-stack build with CRUD and reporting modules.

projects.title: SciMaster AI
projects.description: Adaptive science learning concept with AI explanations, progress views and guided study sessions.
projects.headline: Study smarter with AI.
projects.problem: Students needed clearer explanations and a way to track mastery over complex science topics.
projects.solution: I modeled an AI-assisted study flow with topic cards, generated explanations and progress analytics.
projects.results: The concept creates a calmer learning loop from question to explanation to review.
projects.timeline: Concept sprint for AI flow, dashboards and learning states.

projects.title: Dashboard System
projects.description: Compact analytics workspace with metric cards, lead tracking, charts and practical reporting workflows.
projects.headline: Business data, easy to scan.
projects.problem: Teams needed fast visibility into leads, revenue and operations without spreadsheet-heavy reporting.
projects.solution: I designed a dense dashboard system with reusable metrics, chart patterns and admin workflow components.
projects.results: Reporting became easier to scan and business decisions moved faster across core data.
projects.timeline: 4-day prototype covering dashboard shell, charts and table states.
projects.technologies: React, Tailwind CSS, Charts, Admin UI

projects.title: Digital School Tetovo
projects.description: Education platform concept for courses, events, learning paths and student outcome storytelling.
projects.headline: Learn. Code. Grow.
projects.problem: Students and parents needed clearer course discovery, outcomes and event information.
projects.solution: I built an education platform structure around learning paths, proof, events and simple updates.
projects.results: More course interest and a clearer first impression for future learners.
projects.timeline: 5-day concept sprint for structure, UI and responsive behavior.

projects.title: Mobile Booking App
projects.description: Mobile-first booking experience for appointments, availability, confirmations and client history.
projects.headline: Book in seconds.
projects.problem: Clients needed a faster path from service discovery to confirmed appointment.
projects.solution: I designed a mobile flow with clear time slots, confirmation states and admin visibility.
projects.results: The booking journey became shorter, clearer and easier to repeat.
projects.timeline: Mobile prototype sprint with core screens and admin handoff.

projects.title: Portfolio OS
projects.description: Interactive portfolio system with assistant, command palette, admin content and project storytelling.
projects.headline: A portfolio that behaves like software.
projects.problem: A static portfolio could not communicate the depth of software, design and product thinking.
projects.solution: I built an interactive portfolio OS with project browsing, AI assistance and admin-editable content.
projects.results: The portfolio now feels like a product, not just a page.
projects.timeline: Iterative portfolio build with admin and showcase layers.
projects.technologies: React, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS, Local CMS

projects.title: AI Support Console
projects.description: AI-assisted support dashboard for triage, conversation summaries and resolution tracking.
projects.headline: Support work, clarified.
projects.problem: Support teams needed a calmer way to understand issues and prioritize tickets.
projects.solution: I designed an AI console with summaries, suggested categories and resolution metrics.
projects.results: The workflow reduces scanning time and makes ticket state easier to reason about.
projects.timeline: AI dashboard concept with core triage and summary screens.
